title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Household Energy Consumption by Source
prompt:
The table below shows the average annual household energy consumption in a simulated country, broken down by energy source, for the years 2005, 2015, and 2025 (projected). The figures are measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh) per household.

Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类写作任务1的模拟练习。所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据表格信息写一篇至少150词的报告，概括主要特征并进行比较。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。
